application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out to those lateral branches which overhang the rear garden of no.7 Buchanan Close. The previous pruning cuts shall not be exceeded and no pruning shall be carried out anywhere else in the crown. The works shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
description: Works to a tree covered by Tree Preservation Order 433 (2025): oak - reduce lateral branches overhanging rear garden of no.7 by up to 2m.
